headline: Malacañang Urges Scrutiny of Guteza Recantation in Flood-Control Probe
seoTitle: Palace Urges Probe of Guteza Recantation | FMB News
seoDescription: Malacañang called for scrutiny of Orly Guteza's recantation and conflicting accounts connected to the flood-control investigation.
deck: The Palace said investigators should determine the truth behind conflicting sworn accounts tied to allegations in the flood-control inquiry.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang called for investigating authorities to scrutinize the conflicting accounts surrounding retired Marine Orly Guteza's recantation, according to the approved FMB News package.

Guteza, previously identified as a security aide of former representative Zaldy Co, withdrew earlier allegations that he had delivered cash-filled suitcases to former House Speaker Martin Romualdez. The package reports that he subsequently alleged he had been pressured to make accusations.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The recantation adds another layer to an already contested flood-control investigation. A separate August 20 filing by Romualdez's legal team submitted 25 sworn statements disputing cash-delivery allegations.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Conflicting affidavits can affect the credibility and direction of an investigation, but a recantation does not by itself establish which version is true. That determination belongs to the investigating authorities after evaluating evidence and testimony.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for formal action from the Office of the Ombudsman or Department of Justice, including whether investigators seek additional affidavits, testimony or clarification regarding the alleged pressure behind Guteza's earlier statements.
